scripts.build: node scripts/write-build-meta.mjs && npm run catalog:verify && npm run seo:generate && node scripts/verify-canonical-collections.mjs && npm run seo:verify && npm run assets:verify && vite build
scripts.catalog:verify: npm run catalog:generate && node scripts/verify-public-catalog.mjs && node scripts/verify-canonical-collections.mjs
scripts.pages:dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist --compatibility-date=2026-09-02 --compatibility-flag=nodejs_compat
scripts.d1:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply obra-na-mao-comercial --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.d1:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply obra-na-mao-comercial --remote --config wrangler.jsonc

scripts.qa:prepare:core: npm install --no-save --package-lock=false playwright@1.62.1 && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.qa:quick: npm run qa:prepare && node scripts/run-artisys-qa.mjs quick
scripts.qa:full: npm run qa:prepare && node scripts/run-artisys-qa.mjs full
